title: 30A Bella Bonita
meta_description: Welcome to Bella Bonita 30A! This 3BR end unit sleeps 10 and features a golf cart, Peloton, bikes, pools, and walkable Big Chill fun!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THIS HOME: Bella Bonita 30A, meaning: 'Beautiful Beautiful 30A". This lovely 3 bedroom end unit sleeps 10, featuring an open concept living, dining and kitchen complete with a large back patio to enjoy those long summer evenings. For those looking to get some exercise in, the home includes a Peloton bike!

ABOUT THE AREA: Prominence is a charming coastal community nestled between Seagrove Beach and Alys Beach and just 20 minutes to Pier Park. The community features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Residents will enjoy easy access to a beautiful town center, and a 5,000 square foot resort style pool. In the heart of Prominence is The Big Chill (formerly the Hub), a family hot spot for dining, shopping and entertainment, featuring an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen which streams major sporting events, movies under the stars as well as features live music on their very own stage.

BEACH ACCESS: Deer Lake State Park: This state park is roughly 1/2 mile from Prominence. There is an entry fee of $3 per vehicle (2 to 8 passengers) or $2 per pedestrian, bicyclist, and extra passengers. There is a long scenic boardwalk that brings you from the parking lot to the beach and is a five-to-ten minute walk. Beach service is not provided here.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 Queen, ensuite
• Bedroom 3 -- 2 Twin Built-in Bunks over a Queen
• Sleeper Sofa

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 6 Seater Golf Cart
• 2 Bikes
• 2 Community Pools
• Coffee Maker
• Smart TVs
• Full linen package: bedding, bath towels
• Fully stocked kitchen

PROMINENCE POOL NOW HEATED October \& November AND March \& April
6 Seater Golf Cart \& Peloton Bike

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces with overflow parking available on the south side gravel spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
